title: Indonesian Tofu Noodles
subtitle: with Sugar Snap Peas and Roasted Peanuts
description: All you need is one pan and 20 minutes to prepare this lip-smacking dish. Simply stir-fry fresh veggies in Indonesian spices, then toss through satay tofu and slippery noodles.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Peel the carrot, halve lengthwise and thinly slice on an angle. Trim the stems from the sugar snap peas, removing the strings from one side. Coarsely chop the peanuts. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Cut the tofu into 1cm-thick slices.
Soak noodles: Put half the noodles in a large heatproof bowl, cover generously with boiling water and soak for 2 mins, using a fork to gently separate the noodles after they start to soften. Drain.

Warm tofu: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the tofu for 2 mins or until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over medium-high heat and stir-fry the carrot for 3 mins or until starting to soften.

Stir-fry veggies: Add the sugar snap peas and stir-fry for 2 mins or until the veggies are tender but still with crunch. Add the nasi goreng paste, garlic and 125ml (½ cup) water, then cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Serve up: Add the noodles, tofu, 2 tsp soy sauce and 1 tsp honey to the veggies, then stir-fry for 1 min or until warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the tofu noodles among bowls, scatter over the peanuts and enjoy!
Make it yours: Scatter with a handful of chopped fresh coriander leaves for a fragrant Asian twist.
